about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hello! I am Mamadou FOFANA, a passionate full-stack developer creating modern, high-performance, and intuitive web and mobile applications. My goal is to design and deploy solutions that combine efficiency, user experience, scalability, and high availability.
about.p2: Equipped with diverse skills, I work with Next.js, React.js, React Native, Django, Spring Boot, and databases like PostgreSQL/MySQL. I design secure REST APIs (JWT auth) and manage deployments on Cloud & VPS servers.
about.p3: Certified AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, I master AWS cloud fundamentals and VPS hosting. Rigorous and continuous learner, I am also passionate about Data Science.
